description:
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Michelangelo from your hand to the battlefield.
When Michelangelo enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Michelangelo, adding {G}.
When Michelangelo dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
